release.notes_on_special_items: Q1-2022 release definitions: Adjusted EBITA/EBITDA; acquisition-related amortization = amortization of acquired intangibles only. Interest income, net add-back printed as '—' for Q1-2021. Segment 'Other income (expense), net' relates to items in the Interest income and other, net line. Segment operating income (non-GAAP) = OI + restructuring: Americas 24.8, EMEA & APAC 50.6, Total 75.4; Adjusted EBITA 29.8 / 54.9 / 84.7. Adjusted-NI effective tax rate 19.3%. Release labels the metric 'Free cash flow'.

notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).
EPS for pre-spin periods computed by the company on 60,034,311 shares (shares distributed at Separation); basic = diluted. No dividends declared pre-spin (dps_declared=0).
IS line printed 'Interest income and other, net | 225' (income, added to OI); interest_expense_other_net = -0.225. No pension line in Q1 presentation.
Segment net sales in release block = Q1-2022 release sales-change prior-year values (226.2/342.0/568.1); 10-Q Note: Americas 226,159, EMEA & APAC 341,969 thousand.
10-Q segment measure 'segment operating income' (OI + restructuring): Americas 24,766, EMEA & APAC 50,610, Total 75,376 thousand.
